text: Be between 18 and 25 years old (as of September 1, 2025), in good health, friendly to China, willing to abide by Chinese laws, regulations and the rules and regulations of Fuzhou University, and respect Chinese social morality and customs.Non-Chinese citizens holding valid ordinary passports of foreign countries with no criminal records abroad. (4) Educational RequirementsFresh high school graduates or those who have obtained a high school diploma (other diplomas equivalent to high school education are recognized in reference to high school diplomas), with good academic performance.All relevant high school diplomas must be recognized by the education administrative department of the country where they are located and notarized. Fresh graduates must provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school and stamped with the school's official seal. When reporting for enrollment, you must provide the original copy of your graduation diploma and notarized materials for verification. Language Requirements for AdmissionBy 2025, all majors will be taught in Chinese and no majors will be taught in English. Admission requirements: A score of 210 or above on the HSK5 (Chinese Proficiency Test Level 5) certificate, and the certificate should be valid. Graduates from independent Chinese secondary schools in Malaysia are exempted from the Chinese Proficiency Test (as certified by the Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Malaysia). Applicants who have used Chinese as the medium of instruction during high school may use a teaching certificate issued by their high school as an alternative.
